title: Wii Sports Aww
blurb: The Wii Sports 'aww' — the crowd's gentle disappointment when you gutter the ball or miss the shot. It's the kindest failure sound ever programmed: nobody's angry, everyone's just a little sad for you. Play it for near-misses, honest attempts, and moments that deserve sympathy rather than mockery.
origin: The crowd's disappointed 'aww' from Wii Sports.
